npcs.name: NPC_Rival
npcs.note:
In the square, because gate_wait_for_kes sends the player to 광장 and he has to be in it. He was at (-6.2, -7.4), which is 4.15 m from Town_Lab's axis against a collider face 4.70 m out at that bearing -- inside the building, unreachable, and on ground the navmesh bake carves away. This spot is 2.25 m clear of the nearest prop, flat to 0.09 m across 1.5 m, and 3.97 m from Mark_Kes_Approach, which is 2.8 s of walk against kes_summons' 4 s MoveActor timeout -- so the walk-over lands rather than ending in the snap the timeout exists to cover.

ONE schedule entry, and that is load-bearing. The second entry used to walk him to the route head at noon; NpcController.ApplyEntry fires on any change of entry, so the schedule would have marched him out of the field post kes_summons puts him on and rival_first_battle waits for him at. A single entry starting at hour 0 can never change.

npcs.name: NPC_Gardener
npcs.note: In the west field behind the orchard, which is the reason the west lane has a top arm. Moved out of the plaza so the town's six residents are spread over its three streets rather than all standing in one square.

trainers.name: Trainer_Route_Youngster
trainers.note: Sight cone crosses the road from the south verge, between the two tall-grass fields. You walk into it looking at the ledge.

trainers.name: Trainer_Route_Lass
trainers.note: Faces back down the road from the north verge; catches you on the second bend, so the two route trainers never trigger together.

trainers.name: Trainer_Lake_Fisher
trainers.note: On the shore trail, facing the water; triggers as you come north off the beach.

trainers.name: Trainer_Cave_Hiker
trainers.note: Just inside the chamber where the passage opens out -- the first thing the torch light finds.
